'''Water Strike''' is a [[Water spells|water]]-based [[Strike spells|strike spell]] in the [[standard spellbook]], available starting at level 5 [[Magic]]. As an [[Combat spells#Offensive spells|offensive combat spell]] it can only be cast on [[Monster|attackable NPCs]], or other players in a [[Player killing|PvP situation]].

==Damage==
Water Strike's base maximum hit starts at 4 and increases as the player unlocks additional strike spells, up to 8 at level 13 Magic.

As with all combat spells, Water Strike's maximum hit is also increased based on the player's [[Magic damage|magic damage bonus]].

As a water-based spell, Water Strike's maximum hit is also increased against targets that are [[Elemental weakness|weak to water]].

== Notable uses ==

* As a strike spell, Water Strike is one of the only spells that can be used to damage [[Salarin the twisted]]. When used this way, its damage is scaled up to match that of [[Water Bolt]].
